name: Love's Relic
source:
Immerse yourself in the magnetic tale of "Love's Relic," where a university student and his long-time close friend Amber from his hometown find themselves drawn into a whirlwind of attraction, love, and intimacy. Despite their longstanding friendship, they find themselves unable to resist the pull of their physical desires. 

[From [url=https://wargnema.itch.io/loves-relic]itch.io[/url]]
